Standard: For rotary-wing and tiltrotor air vehicles, the flotation device will remain functional through the air vehicle’s water entry. The device needs to be manually inflatable using only one hand, operable from both the left and right. Additionally, the device has a dual chamber with an oral inflation capability. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: The flotation device should be included during crash and fall tests up to the air vehicle’s maximum crash energy.
(2) Lab test: Verify that the flotation device functions in a pool using test subjects of various sizes of occupants for the intended air vehicle user population. Demonstration includes egress from submerged air vehicles, inflation, measurement of freeboard, and boarding of life raft.
